notes.title: The XGen Studios Bundle now includes Defend Your Castle!
notes.content:
We just brought one of our classic games to the Steam platform: Defend Your Castle. You might have gotten in trouble for playing the web version of this game in your computer lab or library at school when you probably were supposed to be studying or researching something important. Sorry teachers! Defend Your Castle is now available alongside Super Motherload (& Motherload Goldium Edition), Stick RPG 2 and The Low Road at a 30% discount if you get them together! Check out the bundle here:

http://store.steampowered.com/bundle/3347/XGen_Studios_Bundle/

Or if you're just looking for a quick dose of nostalgia hop on over to the DYC store page here:

http://store.steampowered.com/app/708710/Defend_Your_Castle/

We also just launched both sound tracks for The Low Road on Steam: [i]Songs On The Low Road[/i] by Win Well and [i]The Low Road OST[/i] by Eric Cheng. You can pick them both up in The Low Road Soundtrack Bundle at 30% off regular price (oh and there's a 30% launch discount too... so let's just say CHEAP!).

http://store.steampowered.com/bundle/4978/The_Low_Road_Soundtrack_Bundle/

Most of all, thank you for playing our games!

- The XGen Studios Team

notes.title: Custom Key Binding added!
notes.content:
A lot of you have been asking about custom key binding. While we have had custom key binding partially implemented in Super Motherload for some time, it was largely broken. Today's update fixes those issues, and allows players playing with a keyboard, or even multiple players on the same machine using a keyboard, to bind keys of their choosing. Custom key bindings are saved automatically.

While Super Motherload still plays best with a gamepad, for those playing with a Keyboard please note that keyboard ghosting, a hardware limitation of pretty much all keyboards, will make some key combinations work less than optimally, especially when playing with several players on a single keyboard.  

If you do have an extra keyboard (or three) kicking around, you can plug multiple keyboards into the same system to mitigate ghosting with multiple players.

More information on keyboard ghosting is [url=http://www.microsoft.com/appliedsciences/antighostingexplained.mspx]available here[/url]:

notes.content:
Super Motherload now has a series of 6 Trading Cards on Steam!

You can use each set of 6 cards to craft 5 badge levels in sequence. Also included with the Trading Card release are 3 backgrounds, 6 emoticons, and a booster pack.

notes.title: Particles Added!
notes.content:
With today's update, you'll see streams of dirt chunks fly and exhaust puff from your gas-guzzling drilling machine as you mine way through Mars. 

For those interested in the technical side, it took us a little longer than expected to get particles working properly due to a strange sprite caching issue that was eating up memory unnecessarily each time a particle was recycled. We finally managed to track down and resolve that issue today with what was essentially a one-liner.

We also corrected a few other minor issues in this update - see the complete changelog below.

As always, thank-you for your continued support.

  - The XGen Team


For the complete changelog, please [URL=http://supermotherload.com/changelog/]refer here[/URL]

notes.title: 1.02.03 Update - Direct 3D Support Added!
notes.content:
[b][i]Please note that you will need to select 'Direct 3D' in the Launcher if your video card does not support OpenGL[/i][/b]

First of all, we'd like to thank everyone who bought Super Motherload during it's inaugural week on Steam!  The level of interest has exceeded expectation, and we've received a lot of excellent feedback and information about the PC version, which has helped us to track down and fix and number of issues faster.

The biggest addition to today's update is Direct3D support; this should allow most Steam users with Intel video cards to play Super Motherload.

We're also aware that players with Radeon cards that do not have Catalyst drivers available to them are experiencing issues; we'd love to hear from you on whether this update addresses "black-screen" issues for you.

We're continuing our laser-focus on making the PC version of Super Motherload a great experience, with a goal of updating the live build frequently.

Thanks for your support!

  - The XGen Team


For the complete changelog, please [URL=http://supermotherload.com/changelog/]refer here[/URL]

For the current list of known issues, please [URL=http://steamcommunity.com/app/269110/discussions/5/]refer here[/URL]

notes.title: Now Available on Steam Early Access - Super Motherload
notes.content:
Super Motherload is Now Available on Steam Early Access, 10% off!

Set on Mars in an alternate Cold-War era, Super Motherload is a 1 to 4-player couch co-op digging adventure with storyline by Image Comics' Kurtis Wiebe, a fully voiced cast of Soviet and American characters, and a procedurally-generated world that changes each time you play. Purchase powerful upgrades and supplies for your mining pod as you progress and prosper, as well as rare Specials Abilities with random availability.
